## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem, the resulting behavior, and any migration steps.

## Validation

Record commands and results; explain any checks that could not run.

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` pass.
- [ ] Relevant behavior tests cover the change.
- [ ] Docker build passes for serving or CI changes.
- [ ] Active and affected generated workflows pass actionlint when changed.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` describe the final behavior.
- [ ] New dependencies have a README reason and a decision record.
- [ ] Visual changes include relevant screenshots and 360/768/1280, keyboard, reduced-motion, and no-JavaScript evidence.
- [ ] Fixed-layer API changes include compatibility or migration notes.
